text.en:
There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Director of Higher Education, a
vocational high school in the Municipality of Tagbina, Province of Surigao del Sur, to be known as the
Tagbina-Barobo National Agricultural High School. Academic, industrial, and vocational courses shall be
offered in said school.

Such sum as may be determined by the Minister of Education and Culture and the Minister of
the Budget as being necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be charged to the appropriation of the
Ministry of Education and Culture authorized under Batas Pambansa Blg. 40 for new national schools.
Beginning in 1981, such sum as may be needed for the maintenance and operation of the above authorized
national school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: January 21, 1981
